provenance: Original synthetic benchmark material; no real-world claims.

documents.title: Trial results
documents.content: In 400 small-parcel orders on the day shift, average pick time fell 18%. Oversize orders, night shifts and peak weeks were excluded.

documents.title: Exception log
documents.content: The router required manual recovery for 12 of the 400 orders. No shipments were lost during the trial; a supervisor was present for every recovery.

documents.title: Rollout constraints
documents.content: A full rollout needs six trained supervisors. Two are trained. Training four more takes six weeks; the month has three weeks remaining.

documents.title: Available decisions
documents.content: Management may continue a staffed small-parcel trial, test oversize and night-shift cases, or approve a full rollout after staffing and exception-handling checks.
